steps.speaker: News
steps.content: Abnormal phenomena have appeared all across DisCity. Both Eastside and West District have been affected. The City Council would like to remind citizens to exercise caution when going out.

steps.speaker: News
steps.content: If you encounter any suspicious items, gravity-defying incidents, or unidentified blue creatures, please distance yourself immediately and call the FAC hotline at 1234-12-1234...

steps.speaker: News
steps.content: We now continue our coverage of the DisCars Awards. In a much-lauded move, the Dean of DisCity Film Academy is holding a press conference to announce the ceremony's security plans.

steps.speaker: News
steps.content: <size=30>Preparations for the DisCars are progressing smoothly. The Dean promises that the ceremony will be held as scheduled in two days. Many celebrities have begun checking into hotels across Dillywood, and the media is eagerly awaiting the reappearance of Director Deren...</size>

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Ahem! Everyone, gather around! I have something very important to announce!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: It's your lucky day! Prepare to feast your eyes and ears!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Get ready for DisCity's first ever lion dance!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: N-no, it's great, I'm just a bit shocked...

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Should I wake up the director? Director! Director!
